svg.aria-label: Blueprint-style system architecture diagram of Table Toronto, showing the client apps, the self-hosted VPS envelope containing the API gateway and its supporting services, the self-hosted Postgres/PostGIS data foundation, the offline data pipeline that builds neighbourhood features from Toronto Open Data, and a reference schedule mapping all fifteen architecture decision records onto the drawing.
